name: notion-search-sessions
description:
Search past agent sessions by topic in a periodically refreshed index and return matching session URLs and excerpts. Recently created or updated sessions may not appear; use query_sessions for recent sessions.

If availability is not already known for this connection, call get_tool_access with {} before using this tool. Reuse the returned access map across tools; check the status and restricted_parameters.

lookback.description: How far back to search, such as "30d" or "1y". Leave it out to search the past year.

question.description: What you want to find in past sessions.
